title: DECISION
description: What the authority service concluded about one proposed action, and on what grounds. A decision that cannot name its policy version cannot be audited.

policy.description: Digest of the policy that governed this. Bound by value, not by name - a policy that changed after the decision must not silently re-describe it.

dimensions.description: Five independent axes. Collapsing them is how a one-line change with an irreversible side effect gets waved through.

reasons.description: Why. A refusal with no reason cannot be argued with, and an allow with no reason cannot be reviewed.

grant.description: Digest of the AUTHORITY_GRANT issued, when the verdict is allow.
